title: Quillen adjunctions induce adjunctions of infinity localizations
statement:
A model category here is a complete and cocomplete category with classes $C,F,W$ of cofibrations, fibrations and weak equivalences; $W$ satisfies two-out-of-three and is retract closed, and $(C,F\cap W)$ and $(C\cap W,F)$ are weak factorization systems with functorial factorizations. A weak factorization system means factorization of every morphism and the two mutually characterized diagonal-lifting classes. Trivial means also in $W$. An object is cofibrant when its initial map is in $C$, and fibrant when its terminal map is in $F$. Write $q_{\mathcal M}:\mathcal M\to\mathcal M_\infty=\mathcal M[W^{-1}]_\infty$ for homotopy coherent localization, universal for inverting $W$ including mapping spaces and composition homotopies. Infinity categories are modeled by simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] with fillers for all inner horns (the union of all faces of a standard simplex except a face other than the first or last). All required universes may be enlarged.

Let $L:\mathcal M\rightleftarrows\mathcal N:U$ be an ordinary adjunction between two such model categories and suppose $L$ preserves cofibrations and trivial cofibrations. Then $U$ preserves fibrations and trivial fibrations; $L$ preserves weak equivalences between cofibrant objects and $U$ preserves them between fibrant objects. There is a derived adjunction of infinity categories $\mathbf L L:\mathcal M_\infty\rightleftarrows\mathcal N_\infty:\mathbf R U$, with natural mapping-space equivalences
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal N_\infty}(\mathbf L L(X),Y)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal M_\infty}(X,\mathbf R U(Y)).$$
It is computed by $\mathbf L L(qX)=qL(QX)$ for a cofibrant replacement $QX\to X$ and $\mathbf R U(qY)=qU(TY)$ for a fibrant replacement $Y\to TY$. The derived unit and counit are induced by the ordinary unit and counit with these replacement weak equivalences inverted, as coherent natural transformations. A side that already preserves all weak equivalences agrees with its directly localized functor. These assertions include all mapping spaces and coherent naturality, without assuming enrichment, properness or combinatoriality.

source.place: Cisinski Theorem 7.5.30 and paragraph 7.5.25 (including the dual), printed pp. 383-386. Independently Hinich, Dwyer-Kan localization revisited, arXiv:1311.4128v4, Proposition 1.5.1, pp. 14-15, explicitly for arbitrary model categories. No Stacks tag supplies the infinity-categorical assertion; ordinary derived-adjunction results do not identify its mapping spaces.
